title: The Heroic Tale of Shiba, Mercenary From Another World
description: "The Heroic Tale of Shiba, Mercenary from Another World" begins with the protagonist, who is summoned to another world but treated as "incompetent" and abandoned, and is taken in by Gerald, a mercenary known as a "supernatural killer." Given the name Shiba by Gerald, the protagonist trains under him and eventually demonstrates his talent as a supernatural killer.
author: Katararicku
